generation_method.input_mode: Read each listed artifact as opaque bytes.
generation_method.hash_method: SHA-256 over exact bytes rendered as 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII characters.
generation_method.ordering: Sort entries by repository-relative path using ASCII lexicographic ascending order.
generation_method.text_output: UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings, terminal newline present.

self_binding_validation: Commit X must contain these exact Freeze bytes as the Git blob at self_path; the artifact SHA-256 and exact size of Freeze are computed and reported externally and are not embedded here.
